messages.content: The display-case work slipped again. Final object placement is now Thursday morning, so I need to stay Wednesday night and move my St. Louis return to Thursday. Please leave Monday's outbound alone. The museum expects to release me around noon Thursday.

I found the confirmed itinerary: Delta's Monday, July 20 nonstop from ATL to STL, the Wednesday, July 22 return, and Drury Plaza Hotel St. Louis at the Arch for Monday and Tuesday nights. I will check Thursday flights after noon and availability for Wednesday night without changing anything yet. How much airport transit time should I allow after release?
Allow enough time that I am not rushing. Anything departing after 2:30 p.m. should be workable.

There are two nonstop Delta options on Thursday, July 23. The 3:42 p.m. departure reaches Atlanta at 6:18 p.m. and adds $73.00 to the ticket. A 6:26 p.m. departure arrives at 9:02 p.m. and adds $41.00. Main Cabin is available on both. The 3:42 p.m. flight gives you about three hours and forty minutes from museum release to departure.
Use the 3:42. What can you do about the hotel? I would rather not change properties for one night, but tell me what that costs.

The same room type is sold out Wednesday. Drury can add one night in a Deluxe King at $244.18 including taxes, but you may need to move rooms after checkout Wednesday morning. They can note the linked reservations and hold your luggage during the change. The added night is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time Tuesday, July 21. I also found the Hyatt Regency at the Arch nearby for $218.46 including taxes, with cancellation until 11:59 p.m. July 21, but that would require changing hotels.
The $25.72 difference is not worth moving hotels. Add the Drury night. Before confirming anything, give me the revised trip total and separate the amounts that are changing.

The confirmed itinerary currently totals $856.64, including the transportation allowance. Moving the return adds $73.00, and adding Wednesday night at Drury adds $244.18. The revised trip total would be $1,173.82. Monday's outbound remains unchanged, the first two hotel nights remain unchanged, and there are no separate change fees beyond the airfare difference.
Does that total include the same ground transportation allowance, or did you increase it for Thursday?

It includes the original $70.00 ground transportation allowance unchanged. I did not add another transfer charge because the original plan already included travel from the museum to STL; only the day moves from Wednesday to Thursday. The reservation charges themselves would total $1,103.82, with the $70.00 allowance bringing the expected trip total to $1,173.82.
Good. And the hotel can link the reservations even though the room type changes?

Yes. Drury can link the added Wednesday reservation to the existing stay and note a request to remain in the current room if availability changes. They cannot guarantee that, so the confirmed arrangement may still require moving to the Deluxe King Wednesday. The front desk will store your luggage if the new room is not ready.
That is fine. Confirm the Thursday 3:42 p.m. return and the added Drury night at the total you quoted. Do not touch Monday's flight or the first two nights.

Both changes are confirmed. Delta confirmation D6R8KP now has the original Monday, July 20 ATL-STL flight unchanged and a Thursday, July 23 nonstop departing STL at 3:42 p.m. and arriving ATL at 6:18 p.m.; the airfare increase is $73.00. Drury confirmation DRY-72023A adds Wednesday, July 22 in a Deluxe King for $244.18 including taxes, linked to the existing reservation with the possible room move noted. The added night is refundable until 6:00 p.m. local time July 21. The revised expected trip total is $1,173.82, including the unchanged $70.00 ground transportation allowance.
